recap: After Sir Danvers Carew’s murder, Hyde vanishes and rewards are offered. Jekyll resumes old friendships, dining with Utterson and Lanyon. Then Jekyll shuts his door; Poole says he is confined. Utterson finds Lanyon decayed, doomed, refusing Jekyll’s name. Jekyll writes of an incurable quarrel and extreme seclusion. Lanyon dies within a fortnight. After the funeral, Utterson opens Lanyon’s sealed envelope, not to be opened till Jekyll’s death or disappearance. Utterson prefers speaking with Poole at the door; Poole reports Jekyll confines himself over the laboratory, silent.
